title: Dork's Immersive Portal Gun
description: A portal gun datapack for immersive portals
body:
### Requires Immersive portals 1.21.1 
Requires [Immersive portals fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveportals)
or
[Immersive Portals neoforge](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-portals-neoforge)


thank you for considering my mod!
